nodes.label: Problem: rebuilding the Claude Code setup by hand after each format
nodes.rationale: Copying folders does not work because items may be truncated, outdated or broken after upstream updates.

nodes.label: Expected result: CLI cookbook of installers (scan, research, save, install, checklist)
Public tool, separate private cookbook
nodes.rationale: The cookbook stores the user's data, so the tool can be public only if the single cookbook file lives elsewhere.

nodes.label: Constraint: recipes come from the source repo, never invented
Constraint: no secrets (credentials are logged in again)
Constraint: CLI with TUI in Rust
Out of scope: memories, history, credentials, pacman packages
nodes.rationale: pacman comes from Arch, so system packages are not imported; settings, own CLAUDE.md text and credentials go to the checklist instead of being applied.
